justification: Inspected javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/contexts/ForEachStatementContext.java, StatementContext.java, ForStatementContext.java, and JavaParserFactory.java. The target class is only 75 lines and overrides 3 methods: solveSymbol, solveMethod, and localVariablesExposedToChild. It is a narrow specialization of StatementContext for a ForEachStmt, with the general block/parent resolution logic delegated to the superclass and helper methods; unlike ForStatementContext, it does not accumulate multiple distinct responsibilities or large amounts of logic. This looks cohesive rather than insufficiently modularized.
